fields.label: Grading of treatment effects (Miller and Payne system)

optionLabels.Grade 1: Grade 1: No change or some alteration to individual malignant cells but no reduction in overall cellularity.
optionLabels.Grade 2: Grade 2: A minor loss of tumour cells but overall cellularity still high; up to 30% loss.
optionLabels.Grade 3: Grade 3: Between an estimated 30% and 90% reduction in tumour cells.
optionLabels.Grade 4: Grade 4: A marked disappearance of tumour cells such that only small clusters or widely dispersed individual cells remain; more than 90% loss of tumour cells.
optionLabels.Grade 5: Grade 5: No malignant cells identifiable in sections from the site of the tumour; only vascular fibroelastotic stroma remains often containing macrophages. However, ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) may be present.
